cognitive-complexity-check.desc: Verifies that every function has a SonarQube cognitive complexity score below a maximum.

config.item: max - maximum cognitive complexity allowed per function (default 15).
ignore - list of functions to skip. A file path followed by `::` and the function or `Type::method` (e.g. `src/main.rs::run`, `src/main.rs::Config::new`)

scoring.structural: +1 (plus the current nesting depth) for each `if`, `match`, `for`, `while`, and `loop`. The nesting depth increases inside their bodies, so the same construct costs more the deeper it sits.
scoring.hybrid: +1 (with no nesting penalty) for each `else if` and `else`.
scoring.nesting-only: Closures and nested functions add no increment of their own but do increase the nesting depth for the code inside them.
scoring.flat: +1 for each labeled `break`/`continue`, and +1 for each sequence of like boolean operators, where a change of operator starts a new sequence.
